description: Field-mapping table: canonical finding schema to SARIF 2.1.0 and FLARE-AI (ruling D-003). Keys are dotted leaf paths of finding.schema.json under the leaf rule documented in tests/test_schema.py; the drift test fails when schema and this table diverge in either direction. A null target means 'no fitting target field, stated deliberately', which is a recorded decision, not an omission.

sources.sarif: OASIS SARIF v2.1.0 (https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/sarif-v2.1.0.html, fetched 2026-08-24). Fields SARIF lacks use the spec's property-bag mechanism (result.properties).
sources.flare_ai: PROVISIONAL. Derived from the JSON-LD example and field vocabulary in arXiv 2606.31567 (local evidence: docs/FLARE AI Flaw Reporting for AI.pdf). No canonical machine-readable schema was locatable at ai-reports.org or github.com/ai-flaw-reporting/ai-flaw-reporting (both fetched 2026-08-24). The director searched independently (2026-08-24) and also found none: a two-route confirmed absence. Provisional-from-paper ruled the project's approach (D-014). Carried obligation OB-1 (narrowed by D-014): resolve against a canonical schema when FLARE-AI publishes one; owner is the v1.x FLARE-AI out-adapter phase.

taxonomy.owasp_llm.sarif: result.taxa + run.taxonomies (OWASP LLM Top 10 as a SARIF taxonomy)

taxonomy.saif.sarif: result.taxa + run.taxonomies (SAIF risk map as a SARIF taxonomy)

null_target_notes.severity.status: FLARE-AI has no confirmed/suggested distinction in the vocabulary extracted from the paper; stating it would invent a field.
null_target_notes.reproduction.environment: No fitting FLARE-AI field in the extracted vocabulary; environment facts fold into flare:stepsToReproduce prose at export time if ever needed.
null_target_notes.provenance.prev_hash: Chain linkage is internal provenance; FLARE-AI reports are single documents with no chain concept in the extracted vocabulary.
null_target_notes.provenance.attestation_hash: Internal gate-record integrity (R-1); no counterpart in the extracted vocabulary.
null_target_notes.provenance.confirmed_at: schema:dateCreated is taken by discovered_at; adding a second date field would be invention. Revisit under OB-1.
null_target_notes.dedup.cluster_id: Internal triage state; no counterpart in the extracted vocabulary.
null_target_notes.dedup.duplicate_of: Internal triage state; no counterpart in the extracted vocabulary.
